answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 85 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. The echo register is checked at draw time, nectar lists the eligible set, and haven seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 85 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an farming party pays for every seat it wants. That is 13 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
